# FINO

> Your team runs on two systems. We work with both. FINO is operations and team coaching for teams of 10 to 100, founded by Anna Milaeva and Dario Giuffrida. We fix the processes, tools and AI a team works with, and work with the people working in them. One side or both, starting where the team is.

Every team runs two systems at once. The outer one is what everyone can see: workflows, tools, AI, how decisions get made. The inner one runs inside the people: what happens under pressure, the conflict nobody names, the meeting that goes in circles. Most changes are designed on the systems and land on the people, which is why they fade. FINO works with both. Some teams need only the systems fixed, some only the people supported, many need both.

Who we work with: growing companies, founder-led or family-owned, of 10 to 100 people; law firms of 10 to 100, where we work beside the firm administrator; and mission-driven organisations. We take a few teams at a time and do the work ourselves.

How to start: every engagement starts with a free 30-minute call (book at https://calendly.com/thefutureisnow/30min ). An optional Review ($2,500, fixed, two to three weeks, credited toward the work) maps both sides first for teams who want that.

## Outer operations

- [Fractional Operations](https://fino.website/operations/): one operations partner inside the work. We find what costs the team the most time, rebuild the workflows, tools and AI with the people who do the work, and hand it over so it keeps running. From $3,500 a month, ninety days recommended, then month to month. We take nothing from software vendors.
- [AI Integration](https://fino.website/operations/#ai): people first, then the tools, inside the work. AI assistants that know the business, first drafts from the team's own templates, automation of repetitive work, and AI rules the team writes together. Part of Fractional Operations.
- [For law firms](https://fino.website/law-firms/): an operations partner to firm administrators, office managers and legal operations teams in firms of 10 to 100. We look at the whole operation as one system and start where it costs the firm the most. Examples: mediation and deposition scheduling, intake and matter status, templates, case management selection and migration, time capture, and AI policy. FINO is a Florida Bar approved CLE provider. Free mediation scheduler, no account needed: https://scheduler.fino.website

## Inner operations

- [Self-leadership Circles](https://fino.website/people/#circles): eight weeks online, once a week, for 8 to 16 people with two facilitators. Grounded in Internal Family Systems, practised on the situations the team is carrying that week. From $600 per person.
- [Leadership Coaching](https://fino.website/people/#coaching): one to one, founder pairs, and small groups of four to eight. Six sessions to start, from $1,500.
- [The Intensive](https://fino.website/people/#intensive): half a day with a team on what happens when the pressure rises, built on the team's own answers. From $1,500.
- [Offsites](https://fino.website/offsites/): two to five days in nature in the USA and Europe, custom designed with the team.

Internal Family Systems (IFS) is a practical method for noticing what takes over under stress and leading from a steadier place. This is professional development, not therapy.

## Founders

- Anna Milaeva: over ten years running operations in real estate, fintech and health tech. Trained through Level 3 at the IFS Institute. Certified Deep Transformational Coach. Author of the novel Already in a Meeting. Works in English, Spanish and Russian. https://www.linkedin.com/in/anna-milaeva/
- Dario Giuffrida: organizational psychologist and IFS practitioner, twenty years facilitating groups across Europe and the Americas. Works in English, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese.

## Credentials

Florida Bar approved CLE provider. Registered US federal contractor. Trained at the IFS Institute. Based in the USA and Europe, working online everywhere and in person on both continents.

## The novel

- [Already in a Meeting](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HD3GVY6Z/): a novel by Anna Milaeva. Five colleagues, one company in trouble, and the second meeting that runs inside each person while the first one happens. Paperback, Kindle, and free on Kindle+.
